# InstallSmart.AI

> Independent AI strategy and advisory for London SMEs. No software to sell and no referral fees: we tell you what to build, what to buy and who to hire, then oversee the delivery. A trading name of Kaizen Finance Ltd.

## Services
- [AI Consultant London](https://installsmart.ai/services/ai-consultant-london): vendor-neutral AI strategy for SMEs
- [AI Readiness Assessment](https://installsmart.ai/services/ai-readiness-assessment): gaps, priorities and quick wins, fixed fee
- [AI Vendor Selection](https://installsmart.ai/services/ai-vendor-selection): independent evaluation, no commissions
- [AI Efficiency Audit](https://installsmart.ai/services/ai-efficiency-audit): 2-hour deep dive and prioritised action plan, £495
- [AI Growth Partner](https://installsmart.ai/services/ai-growth-partner): fractional AI partner retainer
